description: This file defines the ApiException class within the SuiteCRM API v8 exception namespace. It extends LangException and provides mechanisms for handling API-related exceptions, including setting details, source, and HTTP status.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: A custom exception class for API errors in SuiteCRM, providing additional context such as source and detail, and standard HTTP status codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ApiException with a message, code, previous exception, and optional language message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns additional details about the exception, as a LangText object.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets the detailed message for the exception.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source information (pointer or parameter) related to the exception.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source information associated with the exception.

methods.name: getHttpStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception (default 500).
